is_fee_on_transfer_token.meaning: the token used deducts a percentage on each transfer

user_deposits_amount.meaning: amount of tokens the user deposits via increaseTokenBalance(), e.g. 10000 tokens

recorded_balance_exceeds_holdings.meaning: recorded creatorBalance exceeds actual contract token holdings

last_withdrawers_unpaid.meaning: later withdrawers cannot receive their full balance and the last ~1% of withdrawers cannot withdraw anything

assumptions: increaseTokenBalance() is callable by the depositing user without additional authorization qualifiers stated in the report.
The 10,000-token deposit example is illustrative of the deposit amount, not an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: The report gives no numeric definition of the actual received amount after the fee-on-transfer deduction, so the credit-vs-received equality cannot be expressed numerically; represented by the recorded_balance_exceeds_holdings Boolean.

limitations: The 1% fee rate and 1,000,000-token / 10,000-token deficit figures are retained only in symbol meanings; the selected P uses the 10,000-token deposit example and the impact is carried as a Boolean outcome because no received-amount quantity is defined.
Only the last_depositor_loss impact is formalized; balance_inflation, protocol_insolvency and campaign_funding_failures are out of scope for this plan.
